Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a Memo, which reads as follows:
"MEMO The appellant Insurance Company has challenged the Judgment and Award and the claimant had filed MFA No.462/2020 and the said appeal came to settled in Lok-Adalath.
In view of the above the appeal of the Insurance company has become infructuous.
Hence, the appellant seeks for withdraw the appeal as infructuous.
In view of the same, the above appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
The amount deposited by the appellant/Insurance Company be refunded to appellant.
